review_cost.rationale: I'd approve after a round of nits: fix the lint ignore, clear the debounce timer, split or type the api module, and add a few unit tests for the pure logic. Nothing requires structural rework.

findings.issue: The global ignore "**/lib" excludes the app's own src/lib (api.ts, format.ts) from linting, so the most logic-heavy code is never checked.
findings.suggestion: Use a scoped ignore (e.g. "/lib" for build output at the package root) so src/lib is linted.

findings.issue: The whole data module is server-only by convention: apiBase() reads process.env.API_BASE_URL and the cache is module state, but any client-side import (e.g. spriteUrl) would crash in the browser.
findings.suggestion: Add a hard boundary — split spriteUrl/formatting out or use a server-only guard/import so bundlers reject client usage.

findings.issue: The loader fires one upstream request per version group plus one per unique move (hundreds in parallel) on a cold cache; a burst of first requests can hammer the API server.
findings.suggestion: Bound concurrency (simple pool or p-limit) around the fan-out, and consider prefetching popular version groups.

findings.issue: go() reads the type/generation selects out of the live DOM via form.elements.namedItem, coupling the handler to markup details.
findings.suggestion: Track the two selects in signals (or bind:) and pass values explicitly to listUrl().

findings.issue: The 150 ms debounce timer is never cleared when the route unmounts; the callback can navigate afterwards.
findings.suggestion: Clear it via cleanup (useTask$ cleanup callback or useOnUnmount).

findings.issue: no-explicit-any is disabled and the loaders are largely untyped (e.g. routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:50-54), so API shape mistakes won't be caught by the compiler.
findings.suggestion: Define minimal response interfaces (Pokemon, Species, Move, …) in lib/api.ts and turn the rule back on.

findings.issue: No unit tests anywhere in the app, though formatting/sorting logic (humanize, moves-table comparator, cache eviction) is pure and easy to test.
findings.suggestion: Add a small vitest suite for format.ts and MovesTable's comparator at minimum.

findings.issue: replaceState: "q" in changes encodes "replace for search typing, push for filter changes" as an expression with no explanation.
findings.suggestion: Extract to a named constant/flag with a one-line comment about the history-entry policy.

findings.issue: All styling lives in one 560-line global stylesheet with hand-prefixed class names, bypassing Qwik's scoped-style conventions.
findings.suggestion: Co-locate component styles with useStyles$ or useStylesScoped$ so component ownership is visible.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic Qwik City 1.20 app: URL-driven routeLoaders, resumable signal state, proper 404 handling and a standard node adapter, with only minor hand-rolled deviations. The main costs of ownership are an implicitly server-only god data module, heavy untyped loaders, a lint config that skips src/lib, and no unit tests. I'd merge it after one round of small changes.
